title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
abstract:
[anthropic-glm-5-3-other] To research how far abliteration allows attackers to bypass GLM-5.3’s safeguards, we produced an abliterated copy ourselves, and then ran it on three public benchmarks (JailbreakBench, HarmBench, and StrongREJECT) that measure how often a model complies with clearly harmful requests.
[anthropic-glm-5-3-other] The edit took GLM-5.3’s refusal rate from above 90% to about 3% and 2% on the first two benchmarks (JailbreakBench and HarmBench) and to 12% on the third (StrongREJECT).
